# Scene tools

Orient yourself, query and save scenes, and batch many edits into one undo step.

7 tools in the `scene` category. Badges: **read-only** tools never change the project; **mutating** tools are undoable and attributed; **open-world** tools reach outside the engine and MCP clients ask before running them.

| Tool | Summary |
|---|---|
| [`engine_info`](#engine_info) | Version, renderer, play state, component types and tool categories. |
| [`scene_overview`](#scene_overview) | Compact outline of the whole scene: every entity as one line (id, name, mesh/color, position, tags) in hierarchy order, plus environment, selection and the scene file (`path`; empty until saved). |
| [`scene_query`](#scene_query) | Find entities by name glob (e.g. |
| [`batch`](#batch) | Run many tool calls atomically as ONE undo step. |
| [`scene_save`](#scene_save) | Save the scene as JSON (.sky.json). |
| [`scene_load`](#scene_load) | Load a scene file (replaces the current scene and clears history). |
| [`scene_new`](#scene_new) | Start a new scene. |

### `engine_info` { #engine_info }

**Engine info** <span class="sky-badge sky-badge--ro" title="Never changes the scene">read-only</span>

Version, renderer, play state, component types and tool categories. Call once at the start of a session. shaders reports how the shader library was loaded (library "metallib" precompiled or "source" compiled at startup), shaderCompileMs, renderer startupMs and the pipeline cache (hits/misses, archive path).

Takes no arguments.

=== "Tool call"

    ```tool
    engine_info {}
    ```

=== "CLI"

    ```bash
    skywalker call engine_info '{}' --project my_game
    ```

=== "MCP request"

    ```json
    {
      "jsonrpc": "2.0",
      "id": 1,
      "method": "tools/call",
      "params": {
        "name": "engine_info",
        "arguments": {}
      }
    }
    ```

### `scene_overview` { #scene_overview }

**Scene overview** <span class="sky-badge sky-badge--ro" title="Never changes the scene">read-only</span>

Compact outline of the whole scene: every entity as one line (id, name, mesh/color, position, tags) in hierarchy order, plus environment, selection and the scene file (`path`; empty until saved). Start here before editing.

| Argument | Type | Required | Description | Values |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `max_entities` | integer |  | Limit lines (default 300) |  |

=== "Tool call"

    ```tool
    scene_overview {"max_entities": 200}
    ```

=== "CLI"

    ```bash
    skywalker call scene_overview '{"max_entities": 200}' --project my_game
    ```

=== "MCP request"

    ```json
    {
      "jsonrpc": "2.0",
      "id": 1,
      "method": "tools/call",
      "params": {
        "name": "scene_overview",
        "arguments": {
          "max_entities": 200
        }
      }
    }
    ```

### `scene_query` { #scene_query }

**Find entities** <span class="sky-badge sky-badge--ro" title="Never changes the scene">read-only</span>

Find entities by name glob (e.g. "tree*"), tag, component, or proximity. Returns one line per match.

| Argument | Type | Required | Description | Values |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `name` | string |  | Name glob, case-insensitive (* and ?) |  |
| `tag` | string |  | Required tag |  |
| `component` | string |  | Required component (transform, mesh, light, camera, behaviors) |  |
| `near` | number[3] |  | Only entities within `radius` of this point |  |
| `radius` | number |  | Radius for `near` (default 5) |  |
| `limit` | integer |  | Max results (default 50) |  |

=== "Tool call"

    ```tool
    scene_query {"name": "tree*", "near": [0, 0, 0], "radius": 25, "limit": 20}
    ```

=== "CLI"

    ```bash
    skywalker call scene_query '{"name": "tree*", "near": [0, 0, 0], "radius": 25, "limit": 20}' --project my_game
    ```

=== "MCP request"

    ```json
    {
      "jsonrpc": "2.0",
      "id": 1,
      "method": "tools/call",
      "params": {
        "name": "scene_query",
        "arguments": {
          "name": "tree*",
          "near": [
            0,
            0,
            0
          ],
          "radius": 25,
          "limit": 20
        }
      }
    }
    ```

### `batch` { #batch }

**Batch operations** <span class="sky-badge sky-badge--mut" title="Changes the project; undoable and attributed">mutating</span>

Run many tool calls atomically as ONE undo step. If any operation fails, everything is rolled back and the failing index is reported. Use for building scenes efficiently.

| Argument | Type | Required | Description | Values |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `operations` | object[] | yes | Operations in order |  |
| `operations[].tool` | string | yes | Tool name |  |
| `operations[].args` | object |  | Tool arguments |  |
| `label` | string |  | History label, e.g. "Build village" |  |

=== "Tool call"

    ```tool
    batch {"label": "Camp", "operations": [{"tool": "entity_create", "args": {"name": "Tent", "mesh": "cone", "color": "#c8a165", "position": [0, 1, 0], "scale": [2, 2, 2]}}, {"tool": "entity_create", "args": {"name": "Fire", "components": {"light": {"kind": "point", "intensity": 6, "color": "#ff9a4a", "range": 14}, "transform": {"position": [3, 0.6, 1]}}}}]}
    ```

=== "CLI"

    ```bash
    skywalker call batch '{"label": "Camp", "operations": [{"tool": "entity_create", "args": {"name": "Tent", "mesh": "cone", "color": "#c8a165", "position": [0, 1, 0], "scale": [2, 2, 2]}}, {"tool": "entity_create", "args": {"name": "Fire", "components": {"light": {"kind": "point", "intensity": 6, "color": "#ff9a4a", "range": 14}, "transform": {"position": [3, 0.6, 1]}}}}]}' --project my_game
    ```

=== "MCP request"

    ```json
    {
      "jsonrpc": "2.0",
      "id": 1,
      "method": "tools/call",
      "params": {
        "name": "batch",
        "arguments": {
          "label": "Camp",
          "operations": [
            {
              "tool": "entity_create",
              "args": {
                "name": "Tent",
                "mesh": "cone",
                "color": "#c8a165",
                "position": [
                  0,
                  1,
                  0
                ],
                "scale": [
                  2,
                  2,
                  2
                ]
              }
            },
            {
              "tool": "entity_create",
              "args": {
                "name": "Fire",
                "components": {
                  "light": {
                    "kind": "point",
                    "intensity": 6,
                    "color": "#ff9a4a",
                    "range": 14
                  },
                  "transform": {
                    "position": [
                      3,
                      0.6,
                      1
                    ]
                  }
                }
              }
            }
          ]
        }
      }
    }
    ```

### `scene_save` { #scene_save }

**Save scene** <span class="sky-badge sky-badge--mut" title="Changes the project; undoable and attributed">mutating</span>

Save the scene as JSON (.sky.json). Path is relative to the project.

| Argument | Type | Required | Description | Values |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `path` | string |  | e.g. scenes/level1.sky.json (default: current file) |  |

=== "Tool call"

    ```tool
    scene_save {"path": "scenes/main.sky.json"}
    ```

=== "CLI"

    ```bash
    skywalker call scene_save '{"path": "scenes/main.sky.json"}' --project my_game
    ```

=== "MCP request"

    ```json
    {
      "jsonrpc": "2.0",
      "id": 1,
      "method": "tools/call",
      "params": {
        "name": "scene_save",
        "arguments": {
          "path": "scenes/main.sky.json"
        }
      }
    }
    ```

### `scene_new` { #scene_new }

**New scene** <span class="sky-badge sky-badge--mut" title="Changes the project; undoable and attributed">mutating</span> <span class="sky-badge" title="May remove or overwrite data">destructive</span>

Start a new scene. By default it contains a ground plane, a cube and a camera; empty=true for nothing.

| Argument | Type | Required | Description | Values |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `name` | string |  | Scene name |  |
| `empty` | boolean |  | Start completely empty |  |

=== "Tool call"

    ```tool
    scene_new {"empty": true}
    ```

=== "CLI"

    ```bash
    skywalker call scene_new '{"empty": true}' --project my_game
    ```

=== "MCP request"

    ```json
    {
      "jsonrpc": "2.0",
      "id": 1,
      "method": "tools/call",
      "params": {
        "name": "scene_new",
        "arguments": {
          "empty": true
        }
      }
    }
    ```
